title: You Can Report Hazards On Apple Maps Without Touching Your Phone, Here's How - BGR
summary: With Apple Maps open, simply say something like, "Siri, I just saw an accident" or "Siri, there's a moose in the middle of the road." Let's say you're approaching a previously reported Maps incident, but the hazard has been cleared.
